subject: New on the marketplace: USTECH Index Sniper, a US Tech 100 Expert Advisor
preheader: One precise pending order at a time on the Nasdaq index - with the evidence and its weak points shown.
bodyText:
Hi,

We just added a new Expert Advisor to the Algotraders24 marketplace: **USTECH Index Sniper**, built for the US Tech 100 (Nasdaq) index on MetaTrader 5.

**How it trades**

- Waits for an M5 EMA trend and a fresh fair value gap in the same direction
- Places ONE pending order at a time - never a pile of positions
- Manages the trade with break-even and a trailing stop
- London and New York sessions only, and only when the spread is acceptable

**What we show you**

Like every listing, the page shows the full backtest evidence **and its weak points**. For USTECH Index Sniper that includes a result that came almost entirely in 2025 (2026 was flat to negative), a profit that is the product of 2% risk compounding, and a test run on an Exness index symbol with a very large contract size, so the lot sizes in the report do not carry over to other brokers. AT24 rebuilt the equity curve from real candles and the evidence checks passed - that is not a promise of future results. Please read the page, start on a demo account and use a small risk setting.

Your licence key works on one trading account at a time, and you can move it to another account from your dashboard.

Questions? Just reply to this email - it goes straight to our support team.

The Algotraders24 team
